text:
zoe: quick a11y review request for the new Compact Panel (left rail) we shipped in the console beta. noticed a few SR + keyboard issues. PR: https://stash/redwood/pr/4999
hank: thanks. what's the most urgent problem?
meera: on keyboard the panel traps focus when you open it, but arrowing through links jumps between sections unpredictably. VoiceOver also reports duplicate headings sometimes.
zoe: duplicate headings sound bad. we render a visual separator with an H3 and then re-render the same heading inside the container for animation. probably doubling the semantic header.
aria-qa: yep that's likely the cause. cloned DOM during open animation without aria-hidden. VoiceOver linearization reads both.
tj: for focus, are we using roving tabindex or a native listbox?
meera: currently it's a custom roving pattern but we mix role="menu" and anchor links. NVDA treats it like a menu but keyboard behaviour is inconsistent.
hank: suggestion: use role="list" + role="listitem" with roving tabindex if it's a simple list of links, or role="menu" only if it behaves like a menu with Enter to activate. mixing causes a11y tool confusion.
oea: (typo) — meera: agree. simpler markup is better: ul/li with anchor tags, stable DOM order, and manage focus with tabindex. avoids menu semantics.
aria-qa: also check aria-expanded on the toggle button and ensure it ties to aria-controls with the panel id. VO doesn't announce expansion if the ref is missing.
zoe: good catch. we didn't set aria-controls because the panel id is dynamically generated during mount. easy fix: set a deterministic id or attach id on mount then update aria-controls.
tj: visual focus: current focus ring is 1px inset box-shadow which disappears against the panel background. need an outer outline >=2px and a clear offset. keep tokens but compute contrast in dark theme.
meera: I ran a quick contrast check: icon-only buttons inside panel drop below 3:1 on dark theme in hover state. icons need an accessible label and maybe a wider hit target.
hank: add sr-only labels for icon buttons and increase hit area to 44px. also ensure aria-labels are descriptive (e.g., "Open models list" not just "Open").
aria-qa: testing plan: 1) keyboard nav with Tab and Arrow keys across mac/VO and win/NVDA, 2) check heading linearization (no duplicates), 3) verify aria-expanded + aria-controls link, 4) confirm focus ring maintains contrast at 200% zoom, 5) ensure icon buttons have accessible names and 44px target. i'll run tests after fixes.
zoe: action items: meera to collapse duplicate heading nodes during animation (mark clones aria-hidden), tj to switch markup to ul/li anchors and remove menu role, hank to update focus styles & hit target, aria-qa to verify. I'll also add a Storybook interactive case for keyboard walkthrough.
meera: starting on PR changes now. I'll add sr-only copy for headings where needed and ensure no semantic duplicates.
tj: I'll open a follow-up to adjust roles and add unit tests for keyboard behavior.
hank: will prototype focus outline and hit target CSS:```css
.panel__link:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus-600) 75%, black 25%); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px;}
.icon-btn {width: 44px; height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;}
```
aria-qa: thanks all. i'll test once PRs land. ETA: tomorrow AM PT.
zoe: perfect, thanks team :raised_hands:
